title: Microsoft 365: Frontier program expands to preview features in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive and SharePoint
notes: claim 83: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the statement that only enrolled users see Frontier features omits Microsoft's exception for older Frontier agents. The claim that autonomous previews across these workloads are not described is also too broad: Microsoft documents Autopilot's cross-workload actions and approvals. The enrolment paths, licensing qualifications and roadmap details are supported.
